summary: Provide GET endpoint for EDBI form of Net Cost Timeline
description: The net cost timeline on the CCR v4 emission to EDBI is hard to debug without a way to generate it on demand for inspection. The GET /v4/ccr/:id endpoint currently generates something the same shape as the emission to EDBI, but missing various aspects including the net cost timeline. Either define a new endpoint or add a query param flag to GET /v4/ccr/:id endpoint to allow generating and serving the full CCR v4 EDBI message for troubleshooting.

summary: Fix VLIM delete handling for RCQ and DSD RCQ
description: We received a VLIM delete (AP 10304, UPC 1669700666) that did not result in a ledger delete being emitted. The CDC delete did not result in an insertion to the DSD RCQ because of a missing OR NEW.is_deleted clause in the VLIM trigger. Possible fixes: update the VLIM CDC trigger to add an OR NEW.is_deleted clause, or fix the deleteCRUD logic to use the originated_at of the delete message instead of the target message.

summary: Research fix for supplier catalog bottleneck (KeHe)
description: The catalogue endpoint takes a minimum of 7 minutes to yield the response after adding to long-ingress. The handler only takes 2 minutes but the full request takes >7 minutes. Research options: streaming (start streaming after 2 min data gathering), pagination (client specifies limit/offset in number of items), or asynchronous processing (endpoint starts creating catalog, returns job identifier for polling).

summary: Don't copy DSD Ledger Bundle entry to EMR
